question: Should this component expose arbitrary caller-selected scopes for any configured role, or support only a documented bounded scope set for specific roles?
rationale: Scopes participate in the signed authentication boundary, while current main presents this package as a node component with empty scopes; code review cannot safely choose the permanent public authorization contract.

options.title: Define role-aware scopes
options.body: Document allowed scopes per supported role and reject invalid or unrepresentable registrations before any connect request is sent.

options.title: Keep node scopes empty
options.body: Retain the current node-only contract and close or redesign this PR around a separate operator-client mode.

options.title: Allow arbitrary scopes
options.body: Accept caller-selected scope strings but require exact canonical serialization, explicit size limits, compatibility tests, and security review.

recommendation.title: Define role-aware scopes
recommendation.body: Document allowed scopes per supported role and reject invalid or unrepresentable registrations before any connect request is sent.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest recorded history around the current connect signing, scope placeholder, and registry implementation.
